key_decisions.original_text: Serving window / BAL retention not resolved; not blocking testnet launch; continue async. Three options tabled for the Glamsterdam CL serving window: keep 33,024 epochs, reduce to ~14,299 per the EIP-8061 derivation, or reduce to 8,192 per EIP-8383 (already PFI for Hegota, so out of scope for Glamsterdam)
key_decisions.context: Toni Wahrstätter to raise BAL retention on ACDE; Kevaundray Wedderburn to open an async thread

key_decisions.original_text: Hegota devnet strategy: start FOCIL-only and Frames-only devnets separately, then merge into a combined Hegota devnet

PSA (no decision taken on this call): EIP-8142 (BiB) is being withdrawn by its champion, who has proposed EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast) as a replacement; CL teams asked to add ratings ahead of the next ACDC
